    97→    current_runtime_context().source_file_cache.clear()
    98→
    99→
   100→def collect_exclude_dirs(scan_root: Path) -> list[str]:
   101→    """All exclusion directories as absolute paths, for passing to external tools.
   102→
   103→    Combines DEFAULT_EXCLUSIONS (non-glob entries) + get_exclusions() (runtime/config),
   104→    resolves each against *scan_root*. Filters out glob patterns (``*`` in name)
   105→    since most CLI tools want plain directory paths.
   106→    """
   107→    patterns = set()
   108→    for pat in DEFAULT_EXCLUSIONS:
   109→        if "*" not in pat:
   110→            patterns.add(pat)
   111→    patterns.update(p for p in get_exclusions() if p and "*" not in p)
   112→    return [str(scan_root / p) for p in sorted(patterns) if p]
   113→
   114→
   115→def _is_excluded_dir(name: str, rel_path: str, extra: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
   116→    in_default_exclusions = name in DEFAULT_EXCLUSIONS or name.endswith(".egg-info")
   117→    is_virtualenv_dir = name.startswith(".venv") or name.startswith("venv")
   118→    matches_extra_exclusion = bool(
   119→        extra
   120→        and any(
   121→            matches_exclusion(rel_path, exclusion)
   122→            or exclusion == name
   123→            or exclusion == name + "/**"
   124→            or exclusion == name + "/*"
   125→            for exclusion in extra
   126→        )
   127→    )
   128→    return in_default_exclusions or is_virtualenv_dir or matches_extra_exclusion
   129→
   130→
   131→def _find_source_files_cached(
   132→    path: str,
   133→    extensions: tuple[str, ...],
   134→    exclusions: tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
   135→    extra_exclusions: tuple[str, ...] = (),
   136→) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   137→    """Cached file discovery using os.walk with traversal-time pruning."""
   138→    cache_key = (path, extensions, exclusions, extra_exclusions)
   139→    cache = current_runtime_context().source_file_cache
   140→    cached = cache.get(cache_key)
   141→    if cached is not None:
   142→        return cached
   143→
   144→    project_root = get_project_root()
   145→    root = Path(path)
   146→    if not root.is_absolute():
   147→        root = project_root / root
   148→    all_exclusions = (exclusions or ()) + extra_exclusions
   149→    ext_set = set(extensions)
   150→    files: list[str] = []
   151→    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
   152→        rel_dir = _normalize_path_separators(_safe_relpath(dirpath, project_root))
   153→        dirnames[:] = sorted(
   154→            d
   155→            for d in dirnames
   156→            if not _is_excluded_dir(d, rel_dir + "/" + d, all_exclusions)
   157→        )
   158→        for fname in filenames:
   159→            if any(fname.endswith(ext) for ext in ext_set):
   160→                full = os.path.join(dirpath, fname)
   161→                rel_file = _normalize_path_separators(_safe_relpath(full, project_root))
   162→                if all_exclusions and any(
   163→                    matches_exclusion(rel_file, ex) for ex in all_exclusions
   164→                ):
   165→                    continue
   166→                files.append(rel_file)
   167→    result = tuple(sorted(files))
   168→    cache.put(cache_key, result)
   169→    return result
   170→
   171→
   172→def find_source_files(
   173→    path: str | Path, extensions: list[str], exclusions: list[str] | None = None
   174→) -> list[str]:
   175→    """Find all files with given extensions under a path, excluding patterns."""
   176→    return list(
   177→        _find_source_files_cached(
   178→            str(path),
   179→            tuple(extensions),
   180→            tuple(exclusions) if exclusions else None,
   181→            get_exclusions(),
   182→        )
   183→    )
   184→
   185→
   186→def find_ts_files(path: str | Path) -> list[str]:
   187→    return find_source_files(path, [".ts", ".tsx"])
   188→
   189→
   190→def find_tsx_files(path: str | Path) -> list[str]:
   191→    return find_source_files(path, [".tsx"])
   192→
   193→
   194→def find_py_files(path: str | Path) -> list[str]:
   195→    return find_source_files(path, [".py"])

1→"""Cross-platform grep-style helpers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import os
     6→import re
     7→
     8→from desloppify.base.discovery.source import read_file_text as _read_file_text
     9→from desloppify.base.discovery.paths import get_project_root
    10→
    11→
    12→def grep_files(
    13→    pattern: str, file_list: list[str], *, flags: int = 0
    14→) -> list[tuple[str, int, str]]:
    15→    """Search files for a regex pattern. Returns (filepath, lineno, line_text)."""
    16→    compiled = re.compile(pattern, flags)
    17→    results: list[tuple[str, int, str]] = []
    18→    for filepath in file_list:
    19→        abs_path = filepath if os.path.isabs(filepath) else str(get_project_root() / filepath)
    20→        content = _read_file_text(abs_path)
    21→        if content is None:
    22→            continue
    23→        for lineno, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), 1):
    24→            if compiled.search(line):
    25→                results.append((filepath, lineno, line))
    26→    return results
    27→
    28→
    29→def grep_files_containing(
    30→    names: set[str], file_list: list[str], *, word_boundary: bool = True
    31→) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
    32→    r"""Find which files contain which names. Returns {name: set(filepaths)}."""
    33→    if not names:
    34→        return {}
    35→    names_by_length = sorted(names, key=len, reverse=True)
    36→    if word_boundary:
    37→        combined = re.compile(
    38→            r"\b(?:" + "|".join(re.escape(n) for n in names_by_length) + r")\b"
    39→        )
    40→    else:
    41→        combined = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(n) for n in names_by_length))
    42→
    43→    name_to_files: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    44→    for filepath in file_list:
    45→        abs_path = filepath if os.path.isabs(filepath) else str(get_project_root() / filepath)
    46→        content = _read_file_text(abs_path)
    47→        if content is None:
    48→            continue
    49→        found = set(combined.findall(content))
    50→        for name in found & names:
    51→            name_to_files.setdefault(name, set()).add(filepath)
    52→    return name_to_files
    53→
    54→
    55→def grep_count_files(
    56→    name: str, file_list: list[str], *, word_boundary: bool = True
    57→) -> list[str]:
    58→    """Return list of files containing name."""
    59→    if word_boundary:
    60→        pat = re.compile(r"\b" + re.escape(name) + r"\b")
    61→    else:
    62→        pat = re.compile(re.escape(name))
    63→    matching: list[str] = []
    64→    for filepath in file_list:
    65→        abs_path = filepath if os.path.isabs(filepath) else str(get_project_root() / filepath)
    66→        content = _read_file_text(abs_path)
    67→        if content is None:
    68→            continue
    69→        if pat.search(content):
    70→            matching.append(filepath)
    71→    return matching
    72→
    73→
    74→__all__ = [
    75→    "grep_count_files",
    76→    "grep_files",
    77→    "grep_files_containing",
    78→]
    79→

1→"""Stale @deprecated symbol detection."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import json
     6→import logging
     7→import re
     8→from pathlib import Path
     9→from typing import Any
    10→
    11→from desloppify.base.discovery.file_paths import (
    12→
    13→    rel,
    14→
    15→    resolve_path,
    16→
    17→)
    18→
    19→from desloppify.base.discovery.source import find_ts_files
    20→from desloppify.base.output.fallbacks import log_best_effort_failure
    21→from desloppify.base.search.grep import grep_count_files, grep_files
    22→from desloppify.base.output.terminal import colorize, print_table
    23→from desloppify.base.signal_patterns import DEPRECATION_MARKER_RE
    24→from desloppify.languages.typescript.detectors.contracts import DetectorResult
    25→
    26→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    27→def detect_deprecated_result(path: Path) -> DetectorResult[dict[str, Any]]:
    28→    """Find deprecated symbols with explicit population semantics."""
    29→    ts_files = find_ts_files(path)
    30→    hits = grep_files(DEPRECATION_MARKER_RE.pattern, ts_files, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    31→
    32→    entries = []
    33→    seen_symbols = set()  # Deduplicate by file+symbol
    34→    for filepath, lineno, content in hits:
    35→        symbol, kind = _extract_deprecated_symbol(
    36→            filepath,
    37→            lineno,
    38→            content,
    39→            scan_root=path,
    40→        )
    41→        if not symbol:
    42→            continue
    43→        # Deduplicate (same symbol in same file, e.g., multiple @deprecated on interface props)
    44→        key = (filepath, symbol)
    45→        if key in seen_symbols:
    46→            continue
    47→        seen_symbols.add(key)
    48→        importers = (
    49→            _count_importers(symbol, filepath, ts_files=ts_files, scan_root=path)
    50→            if kind == "top-level"
    51→            else -1
    52→        )
    53→        entries.append(
    54→            {
    55→                "file": filepath,
    56→                "line": lineno,
    57→                "symbol": symbol,
    58→                "kind": kind,
    59→                "importers": importers,
    60→            }
    61→        )
    62→    sorted_entries = sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e["importers"])
    63→    return DetectorResult(
    64→        entries=sorted_entries,
    65→        population_kind="deprecated_symbols",
    66→        population_size=len(sorted_entries),
    67→    )
    68→
    69→
    70→def _extract_deprecated_symbol(
    71→    filepath: str,
    72→    lineno: int,
    73→    content: str,
    74→    *,
    75→    scan_root: Path | None = None,
    76→) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
    77→    """Extract the deprecated symbol name and whether it's a top-level or inline deprecation.
    78→
    79→    Returns (symbol_name, kind) where kind is "top-level" or "property".
    80→    """
    81→    try:
    82→        p = _resolve_source_file(filepath, scan_root=scan_root)
    83→        lines = p.read_text().splitlines()
    84→        content_stripped = content.strip()
    85→
    86→        # Case 1: Inline @deprecated on a property/field
    87→        # e.g., `/** @deprecated Use X instead */ fieldName?: Type;`
    88→        # or `/** @deprecated */ export const oldThing = ...`
    89→        if "/**" in content_stripped and "*/" in content_stripped:
    90→            # This is a single-line JSDoc. Check what follows on the same or next line
    91→            after_jsdoc = content_stripped.split("*/", 1)[1].strip()
    92→            if after_jsdoc:
    93→                # Property on same line: `/** @deprecated */ someField?: string;`
    94→                m = re.match(r"(\w+)\s*[?:=]", after_jsdoc)
    95→                if m:
    96→                    return m.group(1), "property"
    97→                # Declaration on same line: `/** @deprecated */ export const foo`
    98→                m = re.match(
    99→                    r"(?:export\s+)?(?:const|let|var|function|class|type|interface|enum)\s+(\w+)",
   100→                    after_jsdoc,
   101→                )
   102→                if m:
   103→                    return m.group(1), "top-level"
   104→
   105→        # Case 2: @deprecated inside a multi-line JSDoc block — check if it's on a property
   106→        # We need to look ahead to find what this annotates
   107→        for offset in range(1, 8):
   108→            idx = lineno - 1 + offset
   109→            if idx >= len(lines):
   110→                break
   111→            src = lines[idx].strip()
   112→            # Skip empty lines, comment continuations, closing comment
   113→            if not src or src.startswith("*") or src.startswith("//"):
   114→                continue
   115→            # Top-level declaration
   116→            m = re.match(
   117→                r"(?:export\s+)?(?:declare\s+)?(?:const|let|var|function|class|type|interface|enum)\s+(\w+)",
   118→                src,
   119→            )
   120→            if m:
   121→                return m.group(1), "top-level"
   122→            # Property/field: `fieldName?: Type;` or `fieldName: Type;`
   123→            m = re.match(r"(\w+)\s*[?:]", src)
   124→            if m:
   125→                return m.group(1), "property"
   126→            break
   127→
   128→        # Case 3: @deprecated as inline comment on same line
   129→        # e.g., `shotImageEntryId?: string; // @deprecated`
   130→        # Check the current line for a preceding field name
   131→        if "//" in content_stripped or "*" in content_stripped:
   132→            # Look at the same line before the @deprecated
   133→            marker_match = re.search(r"@deprecated", content_stripped, re.IGNORECASE)
   134→            line_before = content_stripped
   135→            if marker_match:
   136→                line_before = content_stripped[: marker_match.start()]
   137→            line_before = line_before.strip().rstrip("/*").rstrip("*").strip()
   138→            m = re.search(r"(\w+)\s*[?:]", line_before)
   139→            if m:
   140→                return m.group(1), "property"
   141→
   142→    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
   143→        log_best_effort_failure(
   144→            logger, f"read deprecated source context {filepath}", exc
   145→        )
   146→    return None, "unknown"
   147→
   148→
   149→def _resolve_source_file(filepath: str, *, scan_root: Path | None) -> Path:
   150→    if Path(filepath).is_absolute():
   151→        return Path(filepath)
   152→    if scan_root is not None:
   153→        candidate = scan_root / filepath
   154→        if candidate.exists():
   155→            return candidate
   156→    return Path(resolve_path(filepath))
   157→
   158→
   159→def _count_importers(
   160→    name: str, declaring_file: str, *, ts_files: list[str], scan_root: Path
   161→) -> int:
   162→    if not name:
   163→        return -1
   164→    matching = grep_count_files(name, ts_files, word_boundary=True)
   165→    declaring_resolved = str(
   166→        _resolve_source_file(declaring_file, scan_root=scan_root).resolve()
   167→    )
   168→    count = 0
   169→    for match_file in matching:
   170→        match_resolved = str(_resolve_source_file(match_file, scan_root=scan_root).resolve())
   171→        if match_resolved != declaring_resolved:
   172→            count += 1
   173→    return count
   174→
   175→
   176→def cmd_deprecated(args: Any) -> None:
   177→    result = detect_deprecated_result(Path(args.path))
   178→    entries = result.entries
   179→    if args.json:
   180→        print(
   181→            json.dumps(
   182→                {
   183→                    "count": len(entries),
   184→                    "entries": entries,
   185→                    "population_size": result.population_size,
   186→                },
   187→                indent=2,
   188→            )
   189→        )
   190→        return
   191→
   192→    if not entries:
   193→        print(colorize("No @deprecated annotations found.", "green"))
   194→        return
   195→
   196→    # Separate top-level and property deprecations
   197→    top_level = [e for e in entries if e["kind"] == "top-level"]
   198→    properties = [e for e in entries if e["kind"] == "property"]
   199→
   200→    print(
   201→        colorize(
   202→            f"\nDeprecated symbols: {len(entries)} ({len(top_level)} top-level, {len(properties)} properties)\n",
   203→            "bold",
   204→        )
   205→    )
   206→
   207→    if top_level:
   208→        print(colorize("Top-level (importable):", "cyan"))
   209→        rows = []
   210→        for e in top_level[: args.top]:
   211→            imp = str(e["importers"]) if e["importers"] >= 0 else "?"
   212→            status = (
   213→                colorize("safe to remove", "green")
   214→                if e["importers"] == 0
   215→                else f"{imp} importers"
   216→            )
   217→            rows.append([e["symbol"], rel(e["file"]), status])

1→"""Sync subjective dimensions into the plan queue.
     2→
     3→Two independent sync functions:
     4→
     5→- **sync_unscored_dimensions** — prepend never-scored (placeholder) dimensions
     6→  to the *front* of the queue unconditionally (onboarding priority).

    38→WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID = "workflow::import-scores"

    45→# Result dataclasses

    47→

    67→    @property

    71→
    72→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    73→# ID helpers
    74→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    75→
    76→def _current_stale_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    77→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently stale."""
    78→    return stale_policy_mod.current_stale_ids(
    79→        state,
    80→        subjective_prefix=SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX,
    81→    )
    82→
    83→

    85→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently unscored (placeholder).
    86→
    87→    Checks ``subjective_assessments`` first; when that dict is empty
    88→    (common before any reviews have been run), falls through to
    89→    ``dimension_scores`` which carries placeholder metadata from scan.
    90→    """
    91→    return stale_policy_mod.current_unscored_ids(
    92→        state,
    93→        subjective_prefix=SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX,

    97→def current_under_target_ids(
    98→    state: StateModel,
    99→    *,
   100→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
   101→) -> set[str]:
   102→    """Return ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are under target but not stale or unscored.
   103→
   104→    These are dimensions whose assessment is still current (not needing refresh)
   105→    but whose score hasn't reached the target yet.

   107→    return stale_policy_mod.current_under_target_ids(

   113→
   114→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   115→# Helpers for sync_stale_dimensions / sync_unscored_dimensions
   116→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   117→
   118→def _has_objective_backlog(
   119→    state: StateModel,
   120→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None,
   121→) -> bool:
   122→    """Return whether an objective backlog exists (open non-subjective issues)."""
   123→    if policy is not None:
   124→        return policy.has_objective_backlog
   125→    return any(
   126→        f.get("status") == "open"
   127→        and f.get("detector") not in _NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   128→        and not f.get("suppressed")
   129→        for f in state.get("issues", {}).values()
   130→    )
   131→
   132→
   133→def _prune_subjective_ids(
   134→    order: list[str],
   135→    *,
   136→    keep_ids: set[str],
   137→    pruned: list[str],
   138→) -> None:
   139→    """Remove subjective IDs from *order* that are not in *keep_ids*, appending removed to *pruned*."""
   140→    to_remove = [
   141→        fid for fid in order
   142→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   143→        and fid not in keep_ids
   144→    ]
   145→    for fid in to_remove:
   146→        order.remove(fid)
   147→        pruned.append(fid)
   148→
   149→
   150→def _inject_subjective_ids(
   151→    order: list[str],
   152→    plan: PlanModel,
   153→    *,
   154→    inject_ids: set[str],
   155→    to_front: bool,
   156→    injected: list[str],
   157→) -> None:
   158→    """Inject subjective IDs into *order* if not already present.
   159→
   160→    When *to_front* is True, inserts after promoted items (front of queue).
   161→    Otherwise appends to the back.
   162→    """
   163→    existing = set(order)
   164→    if to_front:
   165→        insert_at = promoted_insertion_index(order, plan)
   166→        for sid in reversed(sorted(inject_ids)):
   167→            if sid not in existing:
   168→                order.insert(insert_at, sid)
   169→                injected.append(sid)
   170→    else:
   171→        for sid in sorted(inject_ids):
   172→            if sid not in existing:
   173→                order.append(sid)
   174→                injected.append(sid)
   175→
   176→
   177→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   178→# Helpers for sync_triage_needed
   179→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   180→
   181→def _open_review_issue_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   182→    """Return set of open issue IDs whose detector is 'review' or 'concerns'."""
   183→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   184→    return {
   185→        fid for fid, f in issues.items()
   186→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   187→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   188→    }
   189→
   190→
   191→def _new_review_ids_since_triage(
   192→    state: StateModel,
   193→    meta: dict,
   194→) -> set[str]:
   195→    """Return review issue IDs that are new since the last triage."""
   196→    current_review_ids = _open_review_issue_ids(state)
   197→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   198→    return current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   199→
   200→
   201→def _prune_all_triage_stages(order: list[str]) -> None:
   202→    """Remove all ``triage::*`` stage IDs from *order*."""
   203→    for sid in TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS:
   204→        while sid in order:
   205→            order.remove(sid)
   206→
   207→
   208→def _inject_pending_triage_stages(
   209→    order: list[str],
   210→    plan: PlanModel,
   211→    confirmed: set[str],
   212→) -> bool:
   213→    """Inject triage stages for pending (unconfirmed) items.
   214→
   215→    Returns True if any stages were injected.
   216→    """
   217→    insert_at = promoted_insertion_index(order, plan)
   218→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "enrich", "commit")
   219→    existing = set(order)
   220→    injected_count = 0
   221→    for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names, strict=False):
   222→        if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   223→            order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   224→            injected_count += 1
   225→    return injected_count > 0
   226→
   227→
   228→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   229→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   230→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   231→
   232→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   233→    plan: PlanModel,
   234→    state: StateModel,
   235→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   236→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   237→
   238→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   239→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   240→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   241→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   242→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   243→    """
   244→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   245→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   246→
   247→    # Mid-cycle: don't inject unscored dimensions — they'll surface at cycle end.
   248→    if plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   249→        return result
   250→
   251→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   252→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   253→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   254→
   255→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   256→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   257→    _prune_subjective_ids(order, keep_ids=unscored_ids | stale_ids, pruned=result.pruned)
   258→
   259→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs after any promoted items -------------
   260→    _inject_subjective_ids(order, plan, inject_ids=unscored_ids, to_front=True, injected=result.injected)
   261→
   262→    return result
   263→
   264→
   265→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   266→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   267→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   268→
   269→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   270→    plan: PlanModel,
   271→    state: StateModel,
   272→    *,
   273→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   274→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   275→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   276→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale and under-target subjective dimensions.
   277→
   278→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   279→       longer stale/under-target and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned
   280→       by ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   281→    2. Inject stale and under-target dimension IDs when either:
   282→       a. No objective items remain (mid-cycle: append to back), OR
   283→       b. A cycle just completed (post-cycle: insert at front so subjective
   284→          review takes priority over new objective issues).
   285→    """
   286→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   287→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   288→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   289→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state)
   290→    injectable_ids = stale_ids | under_target_ids
   291→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   292→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   293→
   294→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   295→    # Only prune IDs that are no longer injectable and not unscored.
   296→    _prune_subjective_ids(order, keep_ids=injectable_ids | unscored_ids, pruned=result.pruned)
   297→
   298→    # --- Inject or evict stale + under-target dimensions -----------------
   299→    has_real_items = _has_objective_backlog(state, policy)
   300→    should_inject = not has_real_items or cycle_just_completed
   301→
   302→    if not should_inject:
   303→        # Mid-cycle with objective backlog: evict any stale/under-target IDs
   304→        # that are present in the queue.  They may have been grandfathered from
   305→        # the unscored phase and should not be visible until the objective
   306→        # backlog clears or a cycle completes.
   307→        to_evict = [
   308→            fid for fid in order
   309→            if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   310→            and fid in injectable_ids
   311→        ]
   312→        for fid in to_evict:
   313→            order.remove(fid)
   314→            result.pruned.append(fid)
   315→
   316→    if should_inject and injectable_ids:
   317→        to_front = cycle_just_completed and has_real_items
   318→        _inject_subjective_ids(order, plan, inject_ids=injectable_ids, to_front=to_front, injected=result.injected)
   319→
   320→    return result
   321→
   322→
   323→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   324→# Triage snapshot hash + sync
   325→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   326→
   327→def review_issue_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   328→    """Hash open review issue IDs to detect changes.
   329→
   330→    Returns empty string when there are no open review issues.
   331→    """
   332→    return stale_policy_mod.review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   333→
   334→
   335→@dataclass
   336→class TriageSyncResult:
   337→    """What changed during a triage sync."""
   338→
   339→    injected: bool = False
   340→    pruned: bool = False
   341→
   342→    @property
   343→    def changes(self) -> int:
   344→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   345→
   346→
   347→def sync_triage_needed(
   348→    plan: PlanModel,
   349→    state: StateModel,
   350→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   351→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review issues change.
   352→
   353→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   354→
   355→    When stages are already present but all new issues have been resolved
   356→    since injection, auto-prunes the stale stages and updates the hash.
   357→
   358→    When issues are *resolved* (current IDs are a subset of previously
   359→    triaged IDs), the snapshot hash is updated silently — no re-triage
   360→    is needed since the user is working through the plan.
   361→    """
   362→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   363→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   364→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   365→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   366→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   367→
   368→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   369→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   370→
   371→    current_hash = review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   372→    last_hash = meta.get("issue_snapshot_hash", "")
   373→
   374→    if already_present:
   375→        # Stages present — check if the reason for injection still applies.
   376→        # Only auto-prune when triage was completed before (hash exists),
   377→        # all new issues have been resolved, and no triage work is in
   378→        # progress.  This avoids pruning the initial triage or a
   379→        # user-started triage session.
   380→        if last_hash and not confirmed:
   381→            new_since_triage = _new_review_ids_since_triage(state, meta)
   382→
   383→            if not new_since_triage:
   384→                # No new issues remain — prune stale stages
   385→                _prune_all_triage_stages(order)
   386→                if current_hash:
   387→                    meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   388→                    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   389→                result.pruned = True
   390→        return result
   391→
   392→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash:
   393→        # Distinguish "new issues appeared" from "issues were resolved".
   394→        # Only re-triage when genuinely new issues exist.
   395→        new_since_triage = _new_review_ids_since_triage(state, meta)
   396→
   397→        if new_since_triage:
   398→            # New review issues appeared — re-triage needed
   399→            result.injected = _inject_pending_triage_stages(order, plan, confirmed)
   400→        else:
   401→            # Only resolved issues changed the hash — update silently
   402→            meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   403→            plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   404→
   405→    return result
   406→

   427→    Injects when:
   428→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   429→    - ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` is not already in the queue
   430→
   431→    Positioned after subjective items but before triage/create-plan
   432→    so the user sees their updated strict score right after reviews finish.
   433→    """
   434→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   435→    result = ScoreCheckpointSyncResult()
   436→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   437→
   438→    if WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID in order:
   439→        return result
   440→
   441→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   442→    if policy is not None:
   443→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   444→            return result
   445→    else:
   446→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   447→        if unscored:
   448→            return result
   449→
   450→    # Insert after any subjective items, before triage/workflow/issues
   451→    insert_at = 0
   452→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   453→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX):
   454→            insert_at = i + 1
   455→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID)
   456→    result.injected = True
   457→    return result
   458→
   459→
   460→@dataclass
   461→class CreatePlanSyncResult:
   462→    """What changed during a create-plan sync."""
   463→
   464→    injected: bool = False
   465→
   466→    @property
   467→    def changes(self) -> int:
   468→        return int(self.injected)
   469→
   470→
   471→def sync_create_plan_needed(
   472→    plan: PlanModel,
   473→    state: StateModel,
   474→    *,
   475→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   476→) -> CreatePlanSyncResult:
   477→    """Inject ``workflow::create-plan`` when reviews complete + objective backlog exists.
   478→
   479→    Only injects when:
   480→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   481→    - At least one objective issue exists
   482→    - ``workflow::create-plan`` is not already in the queue
   483→    - No triage stages are pending
   484→    """
   485→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   486→    result = CreatePlanSyncResult()
   487→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   488→
   489→    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in order:
   490→        return result
   491→
   492→    # Don't inject if triage stages are pending
   493→    if any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS):
   494→        return result
   495→
   496→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   497→    if policy is not None:
   498→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   499→            return result
   500→        has_objective = policy.has_objective_backlog
   501→    else:
   502→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   503→        if unscored:
   504→            return result
   505→        issues = state.get("issues", {})
   506→        has_objective = any(
   507→            f.get("status") == "open"
   508→            and f.get("detector") not in _NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   509→            for f in issues.values()
   510→        )
   511→    if not has_objective:
   512→        return result
   513→
   514→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items, at the end of the
   515→    # synthetic block (so create-plan comes after score-checkpoint).
   516→    insert_at = 0
   517→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   518→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(TRIAGE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   519→            insert_at = i + 1
   520→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   521→    result.injected = True
   522→    return result
   523→
   524→
   525→def compute_new_issue_ids(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   526→    """Return the set of open review/concerns issue IDs added since last triage.
   527→
   528→    Returns an empty set when no prior triage has recorded ``triaged_ids``.
   529→    """
   530→    return stale_policy_mod.compute_new_issue_ids(plan, state)
   531→
   532→
   533→def is_triage_stale(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> bool:
   534→    """Side-effect-free check: is triage needed?
   535→
   536→    Returns True when genuinely *new* review issues appeared since the
   537→    last triage.  Triage stage IDs being in the queue alone is not
   538→    sufficient — the new issues that triggered injection may have been
   539→    resolved since then.
   540→
   541→    When issues are merely resolved (current IDs are a subset of
   542→    previously triaged IDs), triage is NOT stale — the user is working
   543→    through the plan.
   544→    """
   545→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   546→    return stale_policy_mod.is_triage_stale(plan, state, triage_ids=TRIAGE_IDS)
   547→
   548→
   549→@dataclass
   550→class ImportScoresSyncResult:
   551→    """What changed during an import-scores sync."""
   552→
   553→    injected: bool = False
   554→
   555→    @property
   556→    def changes(self) -> int:
   557→        return int(self.injected)
   558→
   559→
   560→def sync_import_scores_needed(
   561→    plan: PlanModel,
   562→    state: StateModel,
   563→    *,
   564→    assessment_mode: str | None = None,
   565→) -> ImportScoresSyncResult:
   566→    """Inject ``workflow::import-scores`` after issues-only import.
   567→
   568→    Only injects when:
   569→    - Assessment mode was ``issues_only`` (scores were skipped)
   570→    - ``workflow::import-scores`` is not already in the queue
   571→    - There are assessments in the payload that could be imported
   572→
   573→    Positioned after score-checkpoint, before create-plan.
   574→    """
   575→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   576→    result = ImportScoresSyncResult()
   577→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   578→
   579→    if WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID in order:
   580→        return result
   581→
   582→    # Only inject when scores were skipped (issues-only mode)
   583→    if assessment_mode != "issues_only":
   584→        return result
   585→
   586→    # Insert after any subjective/workflow items
   587→    insert_at = 0
   588→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   589→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(WORKFLOW_PREFIX):
   590→            insert_at = i + 1
   591→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_IMPORT_SCORES_ID)
   592→    result.injected = True
   593→    return result
   594→
   595→
   596→@dataclass
   597→class CommunicateScoreSyncResult:
   598→    """What changed during a communicate-score sync."""
   599→
   600→    injected: bool = False
   601→
   602→    @property
   603→    def changes(self) -> int:
   604→        return int(self.injected)
   605→
   606→
   607→def sync_communicate_score_needed(
   608→    plan: PlanModel,
   609→    state: StateModel,
   610→    *,
   611→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   612→    scores_just_imported: bool = False,
   613→) -> CommunicateScoreSyncResult:
   614→    """Inject ``workflow::communicate-score`` when scores should be shown.
   615→
   616→    Injects when either:
   617→    - All initial subjective reviews are complete (no unscored dimensions), OR
   618→    - Scores were just imported (trusted/attested/override)
   619→
   620→    And ``workflow::communicate-score`` is not already in the queue.
   621→    Positioned after subjective items but before triage/create-plan.
   622→    """
   623→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   624→    result = CommunicateScoreSyncResult()
   625→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   626→
   627→    # Also treat legacy score-checkpoint as already-present
   628→    if WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID in order or WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID in order:
   629→        return result
   630→
   631→    # Trigger 1: scores just imported
   632→    should_inject = scores_just_imported
   633→
   634→    # Trigger 2: all initial reviews complete (no unscored dimensions)
   635→    if not should_inject:
   636→        if policy is not None:
   637→            should_inject = not policy.unscored_ids
   638→        else:
   639→            should_inject = not current_unscored_ids(state)
   640→
   641→    if not should_inject:
   642→        return result
   643→
   644→    # Insert after any subjective items, before triage/workflow/issues
   645→    insert_at = 0
   646→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   647→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX):
   648→            insert_at = i + 1
   649→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID)
   650→    result.injected = True
   651→    return result
   652→
   653→
   654→__all__ = [
   655→    "SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX",
   656→    "TRIAGE_ID",
   657→    "TRIAGE_IDS",
   658→    "TRIAGE_PREFIX",
   659→    "TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS",

1→"""Shared helpers for review subcommands."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→
     6→def parse_dimensions(args: object) -> set[str] | None:
     7→    """Parse ``--dimensions`` from *args* into a set, or ``None`` if absent."""
     8→    raw = getattr(args, "dimensions", None)
     9→    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
    10→        return None
    11→    return {d.strip() for d in raw.split(",") if d.strip()}
    12→

   139→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   140→    completed = [s for s in ("observe", "reflect", "organize") if s in stages]
   141→    if completed:
   142→        return (
   143→            f"TRIAGE MODE ({len(completed)}/4 stages complete) — "
   144→            "complete all stages to exit. Run: desloppify plan triage"
   145→        )
   146→    return (

    58→def _resolve_env_int(name: str, default: int, *, min_value: int = 1) -> int:
    59→    """Read an integer env var with lower-bound clamping."""
    60→    raw_value = os.environ.get(name)
    61→    if raw_value is None:
    62→        return default
    63→    try:
    64→        parsed = int(raw_value)
    65→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
    66→        return default
    67→    return max(min_value, parsed)

    70→def _parse_roslyn_graph_payload(payload: dict) -> dict[str, dict] | None:
    71→    """Parse Roslyn JSON payload into the shared graph format."""
    72→    edge_map: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
    73→    max_edges = _resolve_env_int(
    74→        "DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_MAX_EDGES", _DEFAULT_ROSLYN_MAX_EDGES
    75→    )
    76→    edge_count = 0
    77→
    78→    files = payload.get("files")
    79→    if isinstance(files, list):
    80→        for entry in files:
    81→            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
    82→                continue
    83→            source = entry.get("file")
    84→            if not isinstance(source, str) or not source.strip():
    85→                continue
    86→            source_resolved = _safe_resolve_graph_path(source)
    87→            edge_map[source_resolved]
    88→            imports = entry.get("imports", [])
    89→            if not isinstance(imports, list):
    90→                imports = []
    91→            for target in imports:
    92→                if not isinstance(target, str) or not target.strip():
    93→                    continue
    94→                edge_map[source_resolved].add(_safe_resolve_graph_path(target))
    95→                edge_count += 1
    96→                if edge_count > max_edges:
    97→                    return None
    98→        if edge_map:
    99→            return _build_graph_from_edge_map(edge_map)
   100→        return None
   101→
   102→    edges = payload.get("edges")
   103→    if isinstance(edges, list):
   104→        for edge in edges:
   105→            if not isinstance(edge, dict):
   106→                continue
   107→            source = edge.get("source") or edge.get("from")
   108→            target = edge.get("target") or edge.get("to")
   109→            if not isinstance(source, str) or not source.strip():
   110→                continue
   111→            if not isinstance(target, str) or not target.strip():
   112→                continue
   113→            edge_map[_safe_resolve_graph_path(source)].add(
   114→                _safe_resolve_graph_path(target)
   115→            )
   116→            edge_count += 1
   117→            if edge_count > max_edges:
   118→                return None
   119→        if edge_map:
   120→            return _build_graph_from_edge_map(edge_map)
   121→
   122→    return None
   123→
   124→
   125→def _build_roslyn_command(roslyn_cmd: str, path: Path) -> list[str] | None:
   126→    """Convert command template to argv safely without shell execution."""
   127→    split_posix = os.name != "nt"
   128→    try:
   129→        if "{path}" in roslyn_cmd:
   130→            expanded = roslyn_cmd.replace("{path}", str(path))
   131→            argv = shlex.split(expanded, posix=split_posix)
   132→        else:
   133→            argv = shlex.split(roslyn_cmd, posix=split_posix)
   134→            argv.append(str(path))
   135→    except ValueError:
   136→        return None
   137→    return argv or None
   138→
   139→
   140→def _build_dep_graph_roslyn(
   141→    path: Path, roslyn_cmd: str | None = None
   142→) -> dict[str, dict] | None:
   143→    """Try optional Roslyn-backed graph command, return None on fallback."""
   144→    resolved_roslyn_cmd = (roslyn_cmd or "").strip()
   145→    if not resolved_roslyn_cmd:
   146→        resolved_roslyn_cmd = os.environ.get("DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_CMD", "").strip()
   147→    roslyn_cmd = resolved_roslyn_cmd
   148→    if not roslyn_cmd:
   149→        return None
   150→
   151→    cmd = _build_roslyn_command(roslyn_cmd, path)
   152→    if not cmd:
   153→        return None
   154→    timeout_seconds = _resolve_env_int(
   155→        "DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS",
   156→        _DEFAULT_ROSLYN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
   157→    )
   158→    max_output_bytes = _resolve_env_int(
   159→        "DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES",
   160→        _DEFAULT_ROSLYN_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,
   161→    )
   162→    try:
   163→        proc = subprocess.run(
   164→            cmd,
   165→            shell=False,
   166→            check=False,
   167→            capture_output=True,
   168→            text=False,
   169→            timeout=timeout_seconds,
   170→        )
   171→    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
   172→        return None
   173→    if proc.returncode != 0:
   174→        return None
   175→    stdout_bytes = proc.stdout or b""
   176→    if len(stdout_bytes) > max_output_bytes:
   177→        return None
   178→    payload_text = stdout_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
   179→    if not payload_text:
   180→        return None
   181→    try:
   182→        payload = json.loads(payload_text)
   183→    except json.JSONDecodeError:
   184→        return None
   185→    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   186→        return None
   187→    return _parse_roslyn_graph_payload(payload)
   188→
   189→
   190→def build_dep_graph(path: Path, roslyn_cmd: str | None = None) -> dict[str, dict]:
   191→    """Build a C# dependency graph compatible with shared graph detectors."""
   192→    roslyn_graph = _build_dep_graph_roslyn(path, roslyn_cmd=roslyn_cmd)
   193→    if roslyn_graph is not None:
   194→        return roslyn_graph
   195→
   196→    graph: dict[str, dict] = defaultdict(lambda: {"imports": set(), "importers": set()})
   197→
   198→    cs_files = find_csharp_files(path)
   199→    if not cs_files:
   200→        return finalize_graph({})
   201→
   202→    projects = _find_csproj_files(path)
   203→    project_refs: dict[Path, set[Path]] = {}
   204→    project_root_ns: dict[Path, str | None] = {}
   205→    for p in projects:
   206→        refs, root_ns = _parse_csproj_references(p)
   207→        project_refs[p] = refs | _parse_project_assets_references(p)
   208→        project_root_ns[p] = root_ns
   209→
   210→    file_to_project = _map_file_to_project(cs_files, projects)
   211→
   212→    namespace_to_files: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
   213→    file_to_namespace: dict[str, str | None] = {}
   214→    file_to_usings: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
   215→    entrypoint_files: set[str] = set()
   216→    for filepath in cs_files:
   217→        source = resolve_path(filepath)
   218→        namespace, usings, is_entrypoint = _parse_file_metadata(filepath)
   219→        file_to_namespace[source] = namespace
   220→        file_to_usings[source] = usings
   221→        graph[source]
   222→        if namespace:
   223→            namespace_to_files[namespace].add(source)
   224→        if is_entrypoint:
   225→            entrypoint_files.add(source)
   226→
   227→    # Add project root namespaces as fallback namespace owners.
   228→    for source, proj in file_to_project.items():
   229→        ns = project_root_ns.get(proj)
   230→        if ns and source not in namespace_to_files[ns]:
   231→            namespace_to_files[ns].add(source)
   232→
   233→    project_to_namespaces: dict[Path, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
   234→    for source, ns in file_to_namespace.items():
   235→        if not ns:
   236→            continue
   237→        proj = file_to_project.get(source)
   238→        if proj is not None:
   239→            project_to_namespaces[proj].add(ns)
   240→
   241→    for source, usings in file_to_usings.items():
   242→        proj = file_to_project.get(source)
   243→        allowed_namespaces: set[str] | None = None
   244→        if proj is not None:
   245→            allowed_projects = {proj} | project_refs.get(proj, set())
   246→            allowed_namespaces = set()
   247→            for ap in allowed_projects:
   248→                allowed_namespaces.update(project_to_namespaces.get(ap, set()))
   249→
   250→        for using_ns in usings:
   251→            for target in _expand_namespace_matches(using_ns, namespace_to_files):
   252→                if target == source:
   253→                    continue
   254→                target_ns = file_to_namespace.get(target)
   255→                if (
   256→                    allowed_namespaces is not None
   257→                    and target_ns
   258→                    and target_ns not in allowed_namespaces
   259→                ):
   260→                    continue
   261→                graph[source]["imports"].add(target)
   262→                graph[target]["importers"].add(source)
   263→
   264→    # Mark app bootstrap files as referenced roots to avoid orphan false positives.
   265→    for source in entrypoint_files:
   266→        graph[source]["importers"].add("__entrypoint__")
   267→
   268→    return finalize_graph(dict(graph))
   269→
   270→
   271→def resolve_roslyn_cmd_from_args(args) -> str | None:
   272→    """Resolve roslyn command from detector runtime options."""
   273→    runtime_options = getattr(args, "lang_runtime_options", None)
   274→    if isinstance(runtime_options, dict):
   275→        runtime_value = runtime_options.get("roslyn_cmd", "")
   276→        if isinstance(runtime_value, str) and runtime_value.strip():
   277→            return runtime_value.strip()
   278→    return None
   279→
   280→
   281→def cmd_deps(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   282→    """Show dependency info for a specific C# file or top coupled files."""
   283→    graph = build_dep_graph(Path(args.path), roslyn_cmd=resolve_roslyn_cmd_from_args(args))
   284→    _render_deps_for_graph(args, graph=graph)
   285→
   286→
   287→def cmd_cycles(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   288→    """Show import cycles in C# source files."""
   289→    graph = build_dep_graph(Path(args.path), roslyn_cmd=resolve_roslyn_cmd_from_args(args))
   290→    _render_cycles_for_graph(args, graph=graph)
   291→

     9→@dataclass
    10→class FunctionInfo:
    11→    """Extracted function/method info for cross-language analysis."""

    13→    name: str
    14→    file: str
    15→    line: int
    16→    end_line: int
    17→    loc: int
    18→    body: str
    19→    normalized: str = ""
    20→    body_hash: str = ""

    23→
    24→
    25→@dataclass
    26→class ClassInfo:
    27→    """Extracted class/component info for cross-language analysis.
    28→
    29→    For OOP classes: methods/attributes/base_classes are populated directly.
    30→    For React components: metrics holds hook counts (context_hooks, use_effects, etc.).
    31→    """
    32→
    33→    name: str
    34→    file: str
    35→    line: int
    36→    loc: int

    40→    metrics: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    41→
    42→
    43→@dataclass
    44→class ComplexitySignal:
    45→    """A complexity signal to detect in source files.
    46→
    47→    Either pattern-based (regex matched per line, counted) or compute-based
    48→    (custom function that analyzes content and returns count + label).
    49→    """
    50→
    51→    name: str
    52→    pattern: str | None = None  # regex (None = uses compute fn)
    53→    weight: int = 1
    54→    threshold: int = 0
    55→    compute: Callable | None = None  # (content, lines) -> (count, label) | None
    56→
    57→
    58→@dataclass
    59→class GodRule:
    60→    """A rule for detecting god classes/components.
    61→
    62→    The extract callable pulls a metric from ClassInfo; if it meets the threshold,
    63→    the rule fires and contributes to the "reasons" list.
    64→    """
    65→
    66→    name: str
    67→    description: str
    68→    extract: Callable  # (ClassInfo) -> int
    69→    threshold: int

   132→    """Return a banner string when triage stage IDs are in the queue."""
   133→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   134→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))

   136→    if not has_triage:
   137→        return ""
   138→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   139→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   140→    completed = [s for s in ("observe", "reflect", "organize") if s in stages]
   141→    if completed:
   142→        return (
   143→            f"TRIAGE MODE ({len(completed)}/4 stages complete) — "
   144→            "complete all stages to exit. Run: desloppify plan triage"
   145→        )
   146→    return (
   147→        "TRIAGE MODE — review issues need analysis before fixing. "

    36→def _manual_member_ids(clusters: dict) -> set[str]:
    37→    """Collect all issue IDs belonging to manual (non-auto) clusters."""
    38→    ids: set[str] = set()
    39→    for cluster in clusters.values():
    40→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
    41→            ids.update(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
    42→    return ids
    43→
    44→
    45→def _group_clusterable_issues(
    46→    issues: dict,
    47→    *,
    48→    manual_member_ids: set[str],
    49→) -> tuple[dict[str, list[str]], dict[str, dict]]:
    50→    """Group open, non-suppressed, non-manual issues by detector/subtype key.
    51→
    52→    Returns (groups_by_key, issue_data) where groups_by_key maps grouping keys
    53→    to lists of issue IDs, filtered to clusters >= _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE.
    54→    """
    55→    groups: dict[str, list[str]] = defaultdict(list)
    56→    issue_data: dict[str, dict] = {}
    57→    for fid, issue in issues.items():
    58→        if issue.get("status") != "open":
    59→            continue
    60→        if issue.get("suppressed"):
    61→            continue
    62→        if fid in manual_member_ids:
    63→            continue
    64→
    65→        detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    66→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    67→        key = _grouping_key(issue, meta)
    68→        if key is None:
    69→            continue
    70→
    71→        groups[key].append(fid)
    72→        issue_data[fid] = issue
    73→
    74→    groups = {k: v for k, v in groups.items() if len(v) >= _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE}
    75→    return groups, issue_data
    76→
    77→
    78→def _sync_user_modified_cluster_members(
    79→    plan: dict,
    80→    *,
    81→    clusters: dict,
    82→    existing_name: str,
    83→    member_ids: list[str],
    84→    now: str,
    85→) -> int:
    86→    """Sync member IDs for a user-modified cluster, returns count of changes."""
    87→    cluster = clusters[existing_name]
    88→    changes = 0
    89→    existing_ids = set(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
    90→    new_ids = [fid for fid in member_ids if fid not in existing_ids]
    91→    if new_ids:
    92→        cluster["issue_ids"].extend(new_ids)
    93→        cluster["updated_at"] = now
    94→        changes = 1
    95→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
    96→    for fid in member_ids:
    97→        if fid not in overrides:
    98→            overrides[fid] = {"issue_id": fid, "created_at": now}
    99→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = existing_name
   100→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   101→    return changes

   104→def _subjective_state_sets(
   105→    state: StateModel,
   106→    *,
   107→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None,
   108→    target_strict: float,
   109→) -> tuple[set, set, set]:
   110→    """Return (stale_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_ids) for subjective cluster logic."""
   111→    if policy is not None:
   112→        unscored_ids = policy.unscored_ids
   113→        stale_ids = policy.stale_ids
   114→        under_target_ids = policy.under_target_ids
   115→    else:
   116→        unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   117→        stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   118→        under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   119→    return stale_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_ids
   120→

   122→def _has_objective_backlog(
   123→    issues: dict,
   124→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None,
   125→) -> bool:
   126→    """Check if objective backlog exists (open non-subjective issues)."""
   127→    if policy is not None:
   128→        return policy.has_objective_backlog
   129→    return any(
   130→        f.get("status") == "open"
   131→        and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   132→        and not f.get("suppressed")
   133→        for f in issues.values()
   134→    )

   137→def _sync_auto_cluster(
   138→    plan: dict,
   139→    clusters: dict,
   140→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
   141→    *,
   142→    cluster_key: str,
   143→    cluster_name: str,
   144→    member_ids: list[str],
   145→    description: str,
   146→    action: str,
   147→    now: str,
   148→    optional: bool = False,
   149→) -> int:
   150→    """Create or update an auto-cluster and sync its override entries."""
   151→    changes = 0
   152→    existing_name = existing_by_key.get(cluster_key)
   153→    if existing_name and existing_name in clusters:
   154→        cluster = clusters[existing_name]
   155→        old_ids = set(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   156→        new_ids_set = set(member_ids)
   157→        if (
   158→            old_ids != new_ids_set
   159→            or cluster.get("description") != description
   160→            or cluster.get("action") != action
   161→        ):
   162→            cluster["issue_ids"] = list(member_ids)
   163→            cluster["description"] = description
   164→            cluster["action"] = action
   165→            cluster["updated_at"] = now
   166→            changes = 1
   167→    else:
   168→        new_cluster = {
   169→            "name": cluster_name,
   170→            "description": description,
   171→            "issue_ids": list(member_ids),
   172→            "created_at": now,
   173→            "updated_at": now,
   174→            "auto": True,
   175→            "cluster_key": cluster_key,
   176→            "action": action,
   177→            "user_modified": False,
   178→        }
   179→        if optional:
   180→            new_cluster["optional"] = True
   181→        clusters[cluster_name] = new_cluster
   182→        existing_by_key[cluster_key] = cluster_name
   183→        changes = 1
   184→
   185→    overrides = plan.get("overrides", {})
   186→    current_name = existing_by_key.get(cluster_key, cluster_name)
   187→    for fid in member_ids:
   188→        if fid not in overrides:
   189→            overrides[fid] = {"issue_id": fid, "created_at": now}
   190→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = current_name
   191→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   192→
   193→    return changes
   194→
   195→
   196→def sync_issue_clusters(
   197→    plan: dict,
   198→    issues: dict,
   199→    clusters: dict,
   200→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
   201→    active_auto_keys: set[str],
   202→    now: str,
   203→) -> int:
   204→    """Group open issues by detector/subtype and sync auto-clusters."""
   205→    changes = 0
   206→
   207→    groups, issue_data = _group_clusterable_issues(
   208→        issues, manual_member_ids=_manual_member_ids(clusters)
   209→    )
   210→
   211→    for key, member_ids in groups.items():
   212→        active_auto_keys.add(key)
   213→        cluster_name = _cluster_name_from_key(key)
   214→
   215→        rep = issue_data.get(member_ids[0], {})
   216→        detector = rep.get("detector", "")
   217→        meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   218→        members = [issue_data[fid] for fid in member_ids if fid in issue_data]
   219→
   220→        key_parts = key.split("::")
   221→        subtype = key_parts[2] if len(key_parts) >= 3 else None
   222→
   223→        description = _generate_description(cluster_name, members, meta, subtype)
   224→        action = _generate_action(meta, subtype)
   225→
   226→        existing_name = existing_by_key.get(key)
   227→        if existing_name and existing_name in clusters:
   228→            cluster = clusters[existing_name]
   229→            if cluster.get("user_modified"):
   230→                changes += _sync_user_modified_cluster_members(
   231→                    plan,
   232→                    clusters=clusters,
   233→                    existing_name=existing_name,
   234→                    member_ids=member_ids,
   235→                    now=now,
   236→                )
   237→                continue
   238→
   239→        if cluster_name in clusters and clusters[cluster_name].get("cluster_key") != key:
   240→            cluster_name = f"{cluster_name}-{len(member_ids)}"
   241→
   242→        changes += _sync_auto_cluster(
   243→            plan,
   244→            clusters,
   245→            existing_by_key,
   246→            cluster_key=key,
   247→            cluster_name=cluster_name,
   248→            member_ids=member_ids,
   249→            description=description,
   250→            action=action,
   251→            now=now,
   252→        )
   253→
   254→    return changes
   255→
   256→
   257→def sync_subjective_clusters(
   258→    plan: dict,
   259→    state: StateModel,
   260→    issues: dict,
   261→    clusters: dict,
   262→    existing_by_key: dict[str, str],
   263→    active_auto_keys: set[str],
   264→    now: str,
   265→    *,
   266→    target_strict: float,
   267→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   268→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   269→) -> int:
   270→    """Sync unscored, stale, and under-target subjective dimension clusters."""
   271→    changes = 0
   272→
   273→    all_subjective_ids = sorted(
   274→        fid for fid in plan.get("queue_order", [])
   275→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   276→    )
   277→
   278→    stale_state_ids, under_target_ids, unscored_state_ids = _subjective_state_sets(
   279→        state, policy=policy, target_strict=target_strict
   280→    )
   281→
   282→    unscored_queue_ids = sorted(
   283→        fid for fid in all_subjective_ids if fid in unscored_state_ids
   284→    )
   285→    stale_queue_ids = sorted(
   286→        fid for fid in all_subjective_ids
   287→        if fid in stale_state_ids and fid not in unscored_state_ids
   288→    )
   289→
   290→    if len(unscored_queue_ids) >= _MIN_UNSCORED_CLUSTER_SIZE:
   291→        active_auto_keys.add(_UNSCORED_KEY)
   292→        cli_keys = [fid.removeprefix(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) for fid in unscored_queue_ids]
   293→        description = (
   294→            f"Initial review of {len(unscored_queue_ids)} unscored subjective dimensions"
   295→        )
   296→        action = f"desloppify review --prepare --dimensions {','.join(cli_keys)}"
   297→        changes += _sync_auto_cluster(
   298→            plan,
   299→            clusters,
   300→            existing_by_key,
   301→            cluster_key=_UNSCORED_KEY,
   302→            cluster_name=_UNSCORED_NAME,
   303→            member_ids=unscored_queue_ids,
   304→            description=description,
   305→            action=action,
   306→            now=now,
   307→        )
   308→
   309→    if len(stale_queue_ids) >= _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE:
   310→        active_auto_keys.add(_STALE_KEY)
   311→        cli_keys = [fid.removeprefix(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) for fid in stale_queue_ids]
   312→        description = f"Re-review {len(stale_queue_ids)} stale subjective dimensions"
   313→        action = "desloppify review --prepare --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   314→        changes += _sync_auto_cluster(
   315→            plan,
   316→            clusters,
   317→            existing_by_key,
   318→            cluster_key=_STALE_KEY,
   319→            cluster_name=_STALE_NAME,
   320→            member_ids=stale_queue_ids,
   321→            description=description,
   322→            action=action,
   323→            now=now,
   324→        )
   325→
   326→    under_target_queue_ids = sorted(under_target_ids)
   327→
   328→    prev_ut_cluster = clusters.get(_UNDER_TARGET_NAME, {})
   329→    prev_ut_ids = set(prev_ut_cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   330→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   331→    ut_prune = [
   332→        fid for fid in prev_ut_ids
   333→        if fid not in under_target_ids
   334→        and fid not in stale_state_ids
   335→        and fid not in unscored_state_ids
   336→        and fid in order
   337→    ]
   338→    for fid in ut_prune:
   339→        order.remove(fid)
   340→        changes += 1
   341→
   342→    has_objective_items = _has_objective_backlog(issues, policy)
   343→
   344→    if not has_objective_items and len(under_target_queue_ids) >= _MIN_CLUSTER_SIZE:
   345→        active_auto_keys.add(_UNDER_TARGET_KEY)
   346→        cli_keys = [fid.removeprefix(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) for fid in under_target_queue_ids]
   347→        description = (
   348→            f"Consider re-reviewing {len(under_target_queue_ids)} "
   349→            f"dimensions under target score"
   350→        )
   351→        action = "desloppify review --prepare --dimensions " + ",".join(cli_keys)
   352→        changes += _sync_auto_cluster(
   353→            plan,
   354→            clusters,
   355→            existing_by_key,
   356→            [REDACTED],
   357→            cluster_name=_UNDER_TARGET_NAME,
   358→            member_ids=under_target_queue_ids,
   359→            description=description,
   360→            action=action,
   361→            now=now,
   362→            optional=True,
   363→        )
   364→
   365→        existing_order = set(order)
   366→        for fid in under_target_queue_ids:
   367→            if fid not in existing_order:
   368→                order.append(fid)
   369→
   370→    if has_objective_items and not cycle_just_completed:
   371→        objective_evict = [
   372→            fid for fid in order
   373→            if fid in under_target_ids
   374→        ]
   375→        for fid in objective_evict:
   376→            order.remove(fid)
   377→            changes += 1
   378→
   379→    return changes
   380→
   381→
   382→def prune_stale_clusters(
   383→    plan: dict,
   384→    issues: dict,
   385→    clusters: dict,
   386→    active_auto_keys: set[str],
   387→    now: str,
   388→) -> int:
   389→    """Delete auto-clusters that no longer have matching groups."""
   390→    changes = 0
   391→    for name in list(clusters.keys()):
   392→        cluster = clusters[name]
   393→        if not cluster.get("auto"):
   394→            continue
   395→        ck = cluster.get("cluster_key", "")
   396→        if ck in active_auto_keys:
   397→            continue
   398→        if cluster.get("user_modified"):
   399→            alive = [
   400→                fid for fid in cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   401→                if fid in issues and issues[fid].get("status") == "open"
   402→            ]
   403→            if alive:
   404→                if len(alive) != len(cluster.get("issue_ids", [])):
   405→                    cluster["issue_ids"] = alive
   406→                    cluster["updated_at"] = now
   407→                    changes += 1
   408→                continue
   409→        del clusters[name]
   410→        for fid in cluster.get("issue_ids", []):
   411→            override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(fid)
   412→            if override and override.get("cluster") == name:
   413→                override["cluster"] = None
   414→                override["updated_at"] = now
   415→        if plan.get("active_cluster") == name:
   416→            plan["active_cluster"] = None
   417→        changes += 1
   418→    return changes
   419→
   420→
   421→__all__ = ["prune_stale_clusters", "sync_issue_clusters", "sync_subjective_clusters"]
   422→

   192→    state: StateModel,
   193→    meta: dict,
   194→) -> set[str]:
   195→    """Return review issue IDs that are new since the last triage."""
   196→    current_review_ids = _open_review_issue_ids(state)
   197→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   198→    return current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   199→
   200→
   201→def _prune_all_triage_stages(order: list[str]) -> None:
   202→    """Remove all ``triage::*`` stage IDs from *order*."""
   203→    for sid in TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS:
   204→        while sid in order:
   205→            order.remove(sid)
   206→
   207→
   208→def _inject_pending_triage_stages(
   209→    order: list[str],
   210→    plan: PlanModel,
   211→    confirmed: set[str],
   212→) -> bool:
   213→    """Inject triage stages for pending (unconfirmed) items.
   214→
   215→    Returns True if any stages were injected.
   216→    """
   217→    insert_at = promoted_insertion_index(order, plan)
   218→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "enrich", "commit")
   219→    existing = set(order)
   220→    injected_count = 0
   221→    for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names, strict=False):
   222→        if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   223→            order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   224→            injected_count += 1
   225→    return injected_count > 0
   226→
   227→
   228→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   229→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   230→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   231→
   232→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   233→    plan: PlanModel,
   234→    state: StateModel,
   235→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   236→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   237→
   238→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   239→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   240→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   241→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   242→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   243→    """
   244→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   245→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   246→
   247→    # Mid-cycle: don't inject unscored dimensions — they'll surface at cycle end.
   248→    if plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   249→        return result
   250→
   251→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   252→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   253→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   254→
   255→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   256→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   257→    _prune_subjective_ids(order, keep_ids=unscored_ids | stale_ids, pruned=result.pruned)
   258→
   259→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs after any promoted items -------------
   260→    _inject_subjective_ids(order, plan, inject_ids=unscored_ids, to_front=True, injected=result.injected)
   261→
   262→    return result
   263→
   264→
   265→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   266→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   267→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   268→
   269→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   270→    plan: PlanModel,
   271→    state: StateModel,
   272→    *,
   273→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   274→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   275→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   276→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale and under-target subjective dimensions.
   277→
   278→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   279→       longer stale/under-target and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned
   280→       by ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   281→    2. Inject stale and under-target dimension IDs when either:
   282→       a. No objective items remain (mid-cycle: append to back), OR
   283→       b. A cycle just completed (post-cycle: insert at front so subjective
   284→          review takes priority over new objective issues).
   285→    """
   286→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   287→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   288→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   289→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state)
   290→    injectable_ids = stale_ids | under_target_ids
   291→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   292→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   293→
   294→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   295→    # Only prune IDs that are no longer injectable and not unscored.
   296→    _prune_subjective_ids(order, keep_ids=injectable_ids | unscored_ids, pruned=result.pruned)
   297→
   298→    # --- Inject or evict stale + under-target dimensions -----------------
   299→    has_real_items = _has_objective_backlog(state, policy)
   300→    should_inject = not has_real_items or cycle_just_completed
   301→
   302→    if not should_inject:
   303→        # Mid-cycle with objective backlog: evict any stale/under-target IDs
   304→        # that are present in the queue.  They may have been grandfathered from
   305→        # the unscored phase and should not be visible until the objective
   306→        # backlog clears or a cycle completes.
   307→        to_evict = [
   308→            fid for fid in order
   309→            if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   310→            and fid in injectable_ids
   311→        ]
   312→        for fid in to_evict:
   313→            order.remove(fid)
   314→            result.pruned.append(fid)
   315→
   316→    if should_inject and injectable_ids:
   317→        to_front = cycle_just_completed and has_real_items
   318→        _inject_subjective_ids(order, plan, inject_ids=injectable_ids, to_front=to_front, injected=result.injected)
   319→
   320→    return result
   321→

   323→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   324→# Triage snapshot hash + sync
   325→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   326→
   327→def review_issue_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   328→    """Hash open review issue IDs to detect changes.
   329→
   330→    Returns empty string when there are no open review issues.
   331→    """
   332→    return stale_policy_mod.review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   333→
   334→
   335→@dataclass
   336→class TriageSyncResult:
   337→    """What changed during a triage sync."""
   338→
   339→    injected: bool = False
   340→    pruned: bool = False
   341→
   342→    @property
   343→    def changes(self) -> int:
   344→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   345→
   346→
   347→def sync_triage_needed(
   348→    plan: PlanModel,
   349→    state: StateModel,
   350→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   351→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review issues change.
   352→
   353→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   354→
   355→    When stages are already present but all new issues have been resolved
   356→    since injection, auto-prunes the stale stages and updates the hash.
   357→
   358→    When issues are *resolved* (current IDs are a subset of previously
   359→    triaged IDs), the snapshot hash is updated silently — no re-triage
   360→    is needed since the user is working through the plan.
   361→    """
   362→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   363→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   364→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   365→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   366→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   367→
   368→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   369→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   370→
   371→    current_hash = review_issue_snapshot_hash(state)
   372→    last_hash = meta.get("issue_snapshot_hash", "")
   373→
   374→    if already_present:
   375→        # Stages present — check if the reason for injection still applies.
   376→        # Only auto-prune when triage was completed before (hash exists),
   377→        # all new issues have been resolved, and no triage work is in
   378→        # progress.  This avoids pruning the initial triage or a
   379→        # user-started triage session.
   380→        if last_hash and not confirmed:
   381→            new_since_triage = _new_review_ids_since_triage(state, meta)
   382→
   383→            if not new_since_triage:
   384→                # No new issues remain — prune stale stages
   385→                _prune_all_triage_stages(order)
   386→                if current_hash:
   387→                    meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   388→                    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   389→                result.pruned = True
   390→        return result
   391→
   392→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash:
   393→        # Distinguish "new issues appeared" from "issues were resolved".
   394→        # Only re-triage when genuinely new issues exist.
   395→        new_since_triage = _new_review_ids_since_triage(state, meta)
   396→
   397→        if new_since_triage:
   398→            # New review issues appeared — re-triage needed
   399→            result.injected = _inject_pending_triage_stages(order, plan, confirmed)
   400→        else:
   401→            # Only resolved issues changed the hash — update silently
   402→            meta["issue_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   403→            plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   404→
   405→    return result
   406→

   419→def sync_score_checkpoint_needed(

   424→) -> ScoreCheckpointSyncResult:
   425→    """Inject ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` when all initial reviews complete.
   426→
   427→    Injects when:
   428→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   429→    - ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` is not already in the queue
   430→

   432→    so the user sees their updated strict score right after reviews finish.

   435→    result = ScoreCheckpointSyncResult()
   436→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   437→
   438→    if WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID in order:
   439→        return result
   440→
   441→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   442→    if policy is not None:
   443→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   444→            return result
   445→    else:
   446→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   447→        if unscored:
   448→            return result
   449→
   450→    # Insert after any subjective items, before triage/workflow/issues
   451→    insert_at = 0
   452→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   453→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX):
   454→            insert_at = i + 1
   455→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_SCORE_CHECKPOINT_ID)
   456→    result.injected = True
   457→    return result
